record.paper_title: New Open Problems Related to Old Conjectures by Helleseth
record.context_brief: Characterize spectrum invariance under output scaling
record.original_question: Let L be a finite field and let f : L → L be a map, or more specifically a permutation. Determine necessary and sufficient conditions under which scalar multiplication of the output by any nonzero field element preserves the spectrum: for every b ∈ L×, the map bf defined by (bf)(x) = b f(x) has exactly the same Fourier spectrum as f. Which maps or permutations have this spectrum-invariance property for all nonzero scalars b?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.1 (invariance). Find necessary and sufficient conditions for a map (or permutation) f : L → L to have the property that the spectrum of f is equal to the spectrum of bf for all b ∈ L×.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $L = \mathbb{F}_q$ be a finite field, and let $\psi : L \to \mathbb{C}^\times$ be a fixed nontrivial additive character of $L$. For a map $f : L \to L$, define its Fourier (Walsh) transform at $(a,b) \in L \times L$ by
$$\widehat{f}(a,b) \;=\; \sum_{x \in L} \psi\bigl(a f(x) - b x\bigr),$$
and define the spectrum of $f$ to be the multiset
$$\mathrm{Spec}(f) \;=\; \bigl\{\!\!\bigl\{\, \widehat{f}(a,b) \,:\, (a,b)\in L\times L \,\bigr\}\!\!\bigr\}.$$
For each $b \in L^\times$, let $bf : L \to L$ denote the map $x \mapsto b\cdot f(x)$.

Problem. Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on $f$ (in general, and in the special case where $f$ is a permutation of $L$) for the following spectrum-invariance property to hold:
$$\mathrm{Spec}(bf) \;=\; \mathrm{Spec}(f) \qquad \text{for every } b \in L^\times.$$
Equivalently, characterize all maps (and all permutations) $f : L \to L$ whose Fourier spectrum is unchanged under arbitrary nonzero scalar multiplication of the output.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in a 2014 survey of open problems related to Helleseth's conjectures. A targeted web search found no published characterization of maps or permutations on a finite field whose Walsh/Fourier spectrum is invariant under all nonzero output scalings; the topic remains an active area of research in coding theory and cryptography, but no resolution of this specific characterization question was located.

status_evidence.title: New Open Problems Related to Old Conjectures by Helleseth
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems on Fourier spectra of maps over finite fields, including a problem asking for necessary and sufficient conditions under which Spec(f) = Spec(bf) for all b in L*.
status_evidence.claim: The spectrum-invariance characterization is explicitly stated as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: On a Conjecture of Helleseth
status_evidence.snippet: Work on Helleseth's conjectures about Fourier coefficients of power maps over finite fields, indicating ongoing partial progress but no general characterization of spectrum-invariance under output scaling.
status_evidence.claim: Related Helleseth-type questions on Fourier spectra remain only partially resolved.
